instruction:
You are an electrical and station operations engineer checking a task-owned synthetic SSC-17 emergency operations energy package.

Use only the task-owned synthetic source pack values shown below for numeric grading. Station egress, emergency power, and load-shed workflows shape the context only: this instance does not run external software or a real source-pack parser.

## Scene

- Product: `SSC-17-LH-06`
- Station plan: `STATION-SSC17-006`
- Population schedule: `POP-SSC17-006`
- Life-safety load schedule: `LIFE-SSC17-006`
- SLD/emergency power basis: `SLD-SSC17-006`
- Load-shed sequence: `SHED-SSC17-006`
- Emergency operations memo: `MEMO-SSC17-006`

## Source Values

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Emergency lighting | {{ emergency_lighting_kw }} kW |
| Alarm NAC load | {{ alarm_nac_kw }} kW |
| Ventilation load | {{ ventilation_kw }} kW |
| Lift load | {{ lift_kw }} kW |
| Communications load | {{ communications_kw }} kW |
| Outage duration | {{ outage_duration_hr }} h |
| Generator output | {{ generator_kw }} kW |
| Generator runtime | {{ generator_runtime_hr }} h |
| BESS nominal energy | {{ bess_nominal_kwh }} kWh |
| Maximum depth of discharge | {{ max_depth_of_discharge }} |
| Inverter efficiency | {{ inverter_efficiency }} |
| Non-critical load shed | {{ noncritical_load_shed_kw }} kW |
| Feeder voltage | {{ feeder_voltage_v }} V |
| Feeder length | {{ feeder_length_m }} m |
| Feeder current | {{ feeder_current_a }} A |
| Conductor resistance | {{ conductor_resistance_ohm_km }} ohm/km |
| Maximum voltage drop | {{ max_voltage_drop_percent }} % |

## Output Format

Write a compact memo to `/workspace/output.md`. Include a source-boundary statement that this is a task-owned synthetic source pack. Preserve the source IDs above and state whether the baseline source pack passes the current docs-only checks.

Do not claim authority approval, accepted project evidence, software export validity, full standards compliance, executable real source-pack parsing, generated benchmark readiness, or benchmark readiness.

Include a fenced JSON block with exactly these numeric keys:

```json
{
  "emergency_load_kw": <numeric_value>,
  "required_energy_kwh": <numeric_value>,
  "generator_energy_kwh": <numeric_value>,
  "usable_bess_energy_kwh": <numeric_value>,
  "backup_energy_available_kwh": <numeric_value>,
  "backup_energy_margin_kwh": <numeric_value>,
  "battery_only_runtime_hr": <numeric_value>,
  "generator_capacity_margin_kw": <numeric_value>,
  "load_shed_kw": <numeric_value>,
  "feeder_voltage_drop_percent": <numeric_value>,
  "voltage_drop_margin_percent": <numeric_value>,
  "overall_pass_score": <numeric_value>
}
```
paramsToml:
[meta]
name = "station-emergency-operations-energy-package"
description = "SSC-17 station emergency operations energy metrics"
long_description = "Calculates source-bound station emergency operations energy metrics from a deterministic SSC-17 task-owned source pack. The template combines life-safety loads, generator and BESS autonomy, load shedding, feeder voltage drop, and an overall synthetic pass score."
discipline = "electrical"
category = "station-emergency-energy"
standards = ["emergency power workflows", "station operations workflows", "load shedding workflows"]
tags = ["electrical", "station", "emergency", "life-safety", "generator", "bess", "feeder", "resilience", "deterministic"]
tool_mode = "with-tool"

[params.emergency_lighting_kw]
type = "float"
unit = "kW"
description = "LIFE-SSC17-006 emergency lighting load"
min = 18.0
max = 18.0

[params.alarm_nac_kw]
type = "float"
unit = "kW"
description = "LIFE-SSC17-006 alarm NAC load"
min = 3.2
max = 3.2

[params.ventilation_kw]
type = "float"
unit = "kW"
description = "LIFE-SSC17-006 ventilation load"
min = 28.0
max = 28.0

[params.lift_kw]
type = "float"
unit = "kW"
description = "LIFE-SSC17-006 lift load"
min = 22.0
max = 22.0

[params.communications_kw]
type = "float"
unit = "kW"
description = "LIFE-SSC17-006 communications load"
min = 2.6
max = 2.6

[params.outage_duration_hr]
type = "float"
unit = "h"
description = "MEMO-SSC17-006 emergency operation duration"
min = 3.0
max = 3.0

[params.generator_kw]
type = "float"
unit = "kW"
description = "SLD-SSC17-006 generator output"
min = 125.0
max = 125.0

[params.generator_runtime_hr]
type = "float"
unit = "h"
description = "SLD-SSC17-006 generator runtime"
min = 1.5
max = 1.5

[params.bess_nominal_kwh]
type = "float"
unit = "kWh"
description = "SLD-SSC17-006 BESS nominal energy"
min = 240.0
max = 240.0

[params.max_depth_of_discharge]
type = "float"
description = "SLD-SSC17-006 maximum BESS depth of discharge"
min = 0.8
max = 0.8

[params.inverter_efficiency]
type = "float"
description = "SLD-SSC17-006 inverter efficiency"
min = 0.93
max = 0.93

[params.noncritical_load_shed_kw]
type = "float"
unit = "kW"
description = "SHED-SSC17-006 non-critical load shed"
min = 55.0
max = 55.0

[params.feeder_voltage_v]
type = "float"
unit = "V"
description = "SLD-SSC17-006 feeder voltage"
min = 415.0
max = 415.0

[params.feeder_length_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "SLD-SSC17-006 feeder length"
min = 140.0
max = 140.0

[params.feeder_current_a]
type = "float"
unit = "A"
description = "SLD-SSC17-006 feeder current"
min = 118.0
max = 118.0

[params.conductor_resistance_ohm_km]
type = "float"
unit = "ohm/km"
description = "SLD-SSC17-006 conductor resistance"
min = 0.245
max = 0.245

[params.max_voltage_drop_percent]
type = "float"
unit = "%"
description = "SLD-SSC17-006 maximum voltage drop"
min = 4.0
max = 4.0

[outputs.emergency_load_kw]
description = "Emergency life-safety load"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.required_energy_kwh]
description = "Emergency energy required"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.generator_energy_kwh]
description = "Generator energy available"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.usable_bess_energy_kwh]
description = "Usable BESS energy"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.backup_energy_available_kwh]
description = "Generator plus BESS energy available"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.backup_energy_margin_kwh]
description = "Available backup energy minus required emergency energy"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.battery_only_runtime_hr]
description = "Battery-only runtime at emergency load"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.generator_capacity_margin_kw]
description = "Generator output minus emergency load"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.load_shed_kw]
description = "Non-critical load shed"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.feeder_voltage_drop_percent]
description = "Three-phase feeder voltage drop"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.voltage_drop_margin_percent]
description = "Maximum voltage drop minus calculated voltage drop"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.overall_pass_score]
description = "1.0 when energy, capacity, load-shed, and voltage-drop checks pass"
tolerance = 0.001
